note: Almost no amounts at all — 'to taste', 'a handful', 'a knob of'. Nothing here may be guessed into a number.

source.title: Scrambled Eggs, Properly
source.text:
People overthink this. Here is the whole method.

You need eggs, a knob of butter, salt to taste, and a handful of chives if you have them. Cream
is optional and I do not use it.

Crack the eggs into a cold pan with the butter. Put it on a low heat and stir constantly with a
spatula, scraping the bottom. When it looks nearly done, take it off — it keeps cooking. Salt at
the end. Chives over the top. Serves two, or one if you are honest.
